roles.name: Relational Mentors
roles.desc: Provide trauma-informed mentorship for youth and adults, offering guidance and consistent support.

roles.name: System Navigators
roles.desc: Help with transportation, appointments, and coordination, keeping individuals organized and on track.

roles.name: Marketplace Coaches
roles.desc: Teach job readiness skills, resume building, and financial literacy.

roles.name: Hospitality & Care Team
roles.desc: Support meals, events, and resource distribution while creating a welcoming environment.

roles.name: Pro-Bono & Administrative Support
roles.desc: Provide professional services and administrative/operations support.

roles.name: Media & Production Team
roles.desc: Support the mission through video, photography, design, and content creation.

onboardingSteps: Complete volunteer interest form / phone sign-up
Brief phone or in-person conversation with the volunteer coordinator
Background check (for mentor and navigator roles)
